reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by wetix/responsive-ui (https://github.com/wetix/responsive-ui).
Technology stack: svelte, typescript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: About 栏写 WeTix responsive UI component set 并把主页指到 link.wetix.my/responsive-ui，topic 是 responsive、responsive-ui、svelte3、typescript、ui-components，标着 MIT license，19 stars、142 tags，最新 release 是 v1.1.0-alpha.54。文件区把 .storybook、components、stories、test/slot、__mocks__、public 分开放；README 的 Features 五条是 Responsive by default、Support ES Module and Common JS、Support Server-side Rendering、TypeScript and Sass as First Class Citizen、Compatible with Svelte and SvelteKit，Component List 从 @responsive-ui/accordion、@responsive-ui/action-sheet 一路排下去。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
